verdict.summary_en: Delivery note SN-260914-857 dated 2026-09-14 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony DC Hamburg against PO 4500318697. It lists 19.000 PCS (19) of CMP-GAM-006 Steel Case Grand Heist 6 in 19 packages, gross weight 418 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. It carries a blue DC-HAM receiving stamp dated 19.10.2026 and a red supplier shipping seal. There are no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: The receiver signature line (收货签字) is blank, so no named person confirms receipt.
The remarks field (备注) is empty, and the stamp records no received quantity or condition, so the note does not show whether 19 pieces were actually counted.
observations: Red round supplier seal (Dongguan Precision Housings Co. Ltd, 出货专用章) overlaps the PCS unit cell and the edge of the packages cell. The values underneath are still readable.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 19.10.2026 DC-HAM' is clear.
Quantity is printed as '19.000', read here as 19 using the Chinese/English decimal-point convention. This matches the 19 packages.
No handwriting, strike-throughs or overwrites are visible.
The lower half of the page is blank.
